status: proposed extension; not covered by the third-round design PASS
userRequirement: The time budget should be10 minutes times the number of chunks, including larger reviews rather than a fixed20-minute maximum.

counting.perReviewJob: N=max(1, initially planned primary review chunks). A complete single-call job counts as one chunk.
counting.wholeCodeReview: Sum the planned primary chunk counts/budgets across its model-dimension jobs; expose the per-dimension breakdown and total in progress metadata.
counting.reason: These calls consume the original budget; they do not restart or inflate the clock.

budget.start: Use one captured start time per admitted review/job and a fixed deadline; planning/preparation time after admission and all execution/gather time consume it. Freshness admission is separate.
budget.perCall: At dispatch use the lesser of the per-call allowance and remaining job/review time; apply the deadline to structured calls as well as reviewer-session calls.
budget.validation: Reject invalid/non-finite/unsafe chunk counts or arithmetic; honor deadlines without native timer overflow or resetting on heartbeat.

waitingAndStalls.meaning: The current20-minute setting is an idle-progress watchdog, not the whole-run ceiling. Keep healthy-progress/stall detection separate from the new chunk-derived total.
waitingAndStalls.outerWait: Propagate prepared chunk count, budget and remaining time to daemon/client waiters. Fixed20/30-minute or4-hour caps must not silently cut a healthy review short when its derived budget is larger.
waitingAndStalls.hostTransport: A tools/call request was observed timing out after300s while the daemon later completed. If the host cap cannot track the derived deadline, use bounded resumable status/continuation on the same review job, rather than duplicate model work or abandoning the final result.
waitingAndStalls.cancellation: User cancellation stops the existing job; status polling must never launch a second independent review.

acceptance: At N=1,5,20 the planned budgets are10,50,200 minutes.
A fake clock proves timeout exactly at the derived deadline, and each call receives only remaining time.
Retry, redivision and gather do not reset or extend the original deadline.
A healthy multi-chunk review may run past20 minutes within its calculated total; stalled progress remains independently detectable.
Outer wait/continuation survives a short host timeout without starting duplicate reviews and returns the actual recorded result.
The128K complete-call input cap and independent/degraded review semantics remain unchanged.
reviewGate: The original design completed three rounds and passed. This new timing extension needs a newly authorized review cycle before it can be included in the approved implementation contract.
